PDB:6KN7.title: Human cardiac thin filament in the calcium-free state

PDB:6KN7.caveat: The complex carries cardiac troponin subunits, but the measured actin entity is explicitly alpha-skeletal actin; only the actin rise/twist is admitted as structural context, without transferring cardiac troponin identity or state.
